verdict.rationale: Mesh has a first-party case management solution for prioritising and reviewing alerts, and cases can be filtered by case stage and assignee, so assignment and staged workflow clearly exist. Analysts record case decisions, there is a case audit trail, and the agentic workflow escalates high-risk cases for human review. However, the docs never describe how an operations lead actually assigns cases, configures review stages, or routes cases from analyst review to an escalation tier. Missing for 10: documented case assignment/reassignment actions, configurable stage-to-stage routing and analyst-to-senior escalation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
